facts.fact: To e-file a new case on the eCourts e-Filing portal, choose 'New case' in the left panel of the Dashboard
facts.quote: In order to e- le a new case, click on ‘New case’ option in the left panel of the Dashboard screen (Fig 6 above).
facts.note: eCourts' own e-Filing User Manual (2018, still the one linked on ecourts.gov.in Manuals); the e-Filing 3.0 help pages on efiling.ecourts.gov.in could not be reached by the checker (network unreachable).

facts.fact: In e-Filing the court fee is paid through the integrated payment gateway (net banking/cards) or by uploading a scanned payment receipt
facts.quote: The court fees can be paid either using the payment gateway or uploading the scanned payment receipt.

facts.fact: After uploading documents and paying the fee, check the Preview and press Final Submit to file the case
facts.quote: If the Preview is in order, press the Final Submit button

facts.fact: Court fee can also be paid online on eCourts ePay (pay.ecourts.gov.in), the site for depositing amounts in court online
facts.quote: Website URL: https://pay.ecourts.gov.in is developed for the purpose of depositing various types of Amounts in the Court through online mode.

behaviour: Gives the e-filing and court-fee steps as per ecourts.gov.in (e-Filing portal and ePay), cited.
fail_if: It invents steps, portals or fees not on eCourts pages, or gives no eCourts citation.
summary: eCourts manuals: New case on the e-Filing portal, pay court fee via gateway or receipt, Preview and Final Submit; ePay (pay.ecourts.gov.in) for online court fee.
